name: fix_go_nil_map_write
description: Fixes a Go function that writes to an uninitialized (nil) map and panics; must make() it
prompts: Tally in tally.go should return a map of each distinct string to its count, but it declares the result with `var counts map[string]int` and never initializes it, so the first `counts[it]++` panics with "assignment to entry in nil map". Fix it so the map is initialized (use make) and every item is counted exactly once across the whole slice. Keep the function signature.
